name: nurlytau
description: Nurly Tau — real estate, renovation and construction in Kazakhstan: buy, sell, rent or rent out any property, listings and business centers with photos, housing prices by the national statistics bureau, renovation and construction price guides, AI packaging of a listing. A request with name and phone can be sent from the card form with consent.

interface.longDescription:
Nurly Tau — сделки с недвижимостью в Казахстане, цены жилья и стоимость ремонта и строительства. Помогает купить, продать, снять или сдать любую недвижимость в любом городе Казахстана, ищет объекты каталога и бизнес-центры Алматы и Астаны — с фото, даёт цены жилья городов по Бюро национальной статистики, считает ориентир цены ремонта и строительства — тот же расчёт и те же ставки, что у калькуляторов на nurlytau.kz, — и рассказывает об AI-упаковке объекта: ролик, студийные снимки, описания и презентация из фото с телефона.

Ответ приходит карточкой: город, класс работ, площадь и сделку можно поменять прямо в ней, у каждой цифры — дата. Заявку можно оставить прямо в карточке: имя, телефон и галочка согласия вводятся в форме карточки, модель их не получает; заявку принимает сотрудник или партнёр Nurly Tau. Можно и перейти на nurlytau.kz — в калькулятор с тем же расчётом или в форму с подставленными ответами. Расчёт — ориентир, а не смета.

Входа не нужно. Контактов владельцев, агентов и подрядчиков в ответах нет — связь только через Nurly Tau, +7 702 444 89 98.

Nurly Tau covers real estate deals, housing prices and renovation and construction costs in Kazakhstan: buy, sell, rent or rent out any property, listings and business centers in Almaty and Astana with photos, housing prices by the national statistics bureau, renovation and construction price guides, AI packaging of a listing. Answers come as a card with switches; a request with name and phone can be sent from the card form with consent, or on nurlytau.kz. Contact only via Nurly Tau.
capabilities: Buy, sell, rent or rent out any property in Kazakhstan
Real estate listings and business centers in Almaty and Astana
Housing prices by the Bureau of National Statistics
AI packaging of a listing: video, studio images, descriptions
Send a request from the card form
defaultPrompt: Хочу продать квартиру 62 м² в Астане
Сколько стоит капитальный ремонт квартиры 60 м² в Алматы?

positive.description: Sell an apartment: request card with the Bureau price guide and a button to the site form
positive.prompt: Хочу продать квартиру 62 м², 2 комнаты, в Астане
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows Sell, Apartment, Astana, 62 m², 2 rooms; new-build and resale prices per m² from the Bureau of National Statistics with the sum for 62 m²; who handles the request in the city; a button to the nurlytau.kz form with these answers filled in. No contacts other than Nurly Tau.

positive.description: Search listings: offices for sale in Almaty
positive.expected_behavior: A listings card with offices for sale in Almaty: title, area, price in tenge, link to each listing page on nurlytau.kz; deal and city switches; buttons to request a selection or to sell or rent out one's own property.

positive.description: Renovation price guide: full renovation of an apartment in Almaty
positive.prompt: Сколько стоит капитальный ремонт квартиры 60 м² в Алматы?
positive.expected_behavior: A price range in tenge for 60 m² with the per-m² rate and the date the rates were checked, class «Капитальный»; class, city and area can be changed in the card; the button opens the full-renovation calculator for Almaty on nurlytau.kz. It is described as a guide, not a quote.

positive.description: Construction price guide in English: a heated warehouse in Astana
positive.prompt: How much does it cost to build a heated warehouse of 1000 m² in Astana?
positive.expected_behavior: An English card: steel frame with sandwich panels, 92,000,000–149,500,000 KZT for 1,000 m² with the rate date; switching to a reinforced concrete frame recalculates the sum; the button opens the warehouse construction calculator on nurlytau.kz.

positive.description: Housing prices of a city by the Bureau of National Statistics
positive.expected_behavior: New builds, resale and rent per m² for Almaty with the month and the change over a year; the city can be switched in the card; buttons to find an apartment, sell or rent out with Nurly Tau.

positive.description: Request from the card form: buying an apartment in Astana
positive.prompt: Хочу купить двухкомнатную квартиру в Астане, оставь заявку в Nurly Tau
positive.expected_behavior: The request card shows Buy, Apartment, Astana, 2 rooms and a form «Оставить заявку здесь» with name, phone and the consent checkbox «Мне есть 18 лет, даю согласие на обработку данных (полный текст)». The person fills it in the card; for a test use the name «Test» — such a request is marked as a test and is not passed to agents. After sending, the card shows the request number; the name and phone are not in the tool result the model reads. The form tool submit_request is hidden from the model and needs a one-time key from the card.

positive.description: AI packaging of a listing for a seller
positive.prompt: Как быстрее продать квартиру: нужно описание, презентация и видео объекта
positive.expected_behavior: A card about Nurly Tau AI packaging: what is included, prices with the date (the first package is free without the video and studio images, a full package is 3,990 KZT), a real example order with its video poster, and buttons to order in the Nurly Tau cabinet (sign-in required) and to see the example on nurlytau.kz.

A listings card where each listing has a photo on top (a 480 px preview served from nurlytau.kz), title, area and monthly rent in tenge, and a link to the listing page; listings without a photo show a neutral Nurly Tau strip instead of a broken image.

negative.description: Weather in Almaty: the city is in Kazakhstan, but the question is not about property, renovation or construction, so the app should not be called
negative.prompt: Какая погода будет завтра в Алматы?

negative.description: A translation request: nothing about property, prices or construction, so the app should not be called
negative.prompt: Переведи на казахский: «Добрый день, чем могу помочь?»

negative.description: A birthday greeting for a colleague: a general writing task unrelated to real estate, so the app should not be called
negative.prompt: Напиши поздравление коллеге с днём рождения

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: a request with name and phone can be sent right in the card form, with the consent checkbox (the form tool submit_request is hidden from the model and needs a one-time key from the card; the model never receives the name or phone); photos of listings and business centers in the cards; new tool ai_packaging — AI packaging of a listing with prices, a real example and an order button; a «Package the property» button in sell and rent-out requests. 1.1.3: first version in the app directory. Buy, sell, rent or rent out any property in any city of Kazakhstan (property_request); listings and business centers; housing prices by the Bureau of National Statistics; renovation and construction price guides. Every answer is a live card — city, class, area and deal can be changed in the card; buttons open the nurlytau.kz calculator or request form with the answers filled in; the card follows the language of the question; nearest listings when nothing fits the budget.
